description: Create a post on one or more connected social accounts. Call list_social_accounts first and only use accounts with can_post: true, copying their platform_slug and uid exactly — never guess platform_slug. You must choose exactly one of: scheduled_at (ISO 8601 with timezone offset or Z, in the future) to schedule, or publish_now: true to publish to the real accounts immediately. Publishing is irreversible — only set publish_now after the user has explicitly asked to publish now; when in doubt, schedule.

content_type.description: Kind of content this post is

media_uids.description: Feedlio media file uids to attach, from list_media or add_media_from_url. Never invent one.

platforms.description: One or more platform accounts to post to

platform_slug.description: The exact platform_slug returned by list_social_accounts for this account. Do not guess or infer it from the account name — call list_social_accounts first and use its platform_slug field verbatim. Only accounts with can_post: true are accepted.

social_account_uid.description: uid of the connected account, from list_social_accounts

publish_now.description: Set true to publish immediately instead of scheduling. Irreversible — requires the user to have explicitly asked for immediate publishing.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime to schedule the post (e.g. 2026-09-15T10:00:00+06:00). Required unless publish_now is true.

name: create_post
title: Create or schedule a post
